fisher_numerical_contract.arithmetic: CUDA FP64 fixed32 recurrence + B14 asymptotic; stable paired differences
fisher_numerical_contract.relative_quadratic_error_denominator: Exact mathematical Fisher quadratic, not computed quadratic: eta/(gap_lower-eta)
fisher_numerical_contract.scope: Conditional engineering bound assuming standard RN FP64 elementary arithmetic and gradual underflow; independently validate on queued CUDA references. Not a hardware proof.

stage_diagnostics.scope: All three banks evaluated on the same saved old-policy observations and frozen per-row normalization; not their own future occupancy. RMS ratios and mix/gain changes do not alone establish a cause of return collapse.

optimizer_metadata.history_scope: Actual Args and checkpoint-state presence only; no optimizer moments are decoded, matched to layers, transported or used to propose new steps.

scope: Full saved old batch, action-summed/state-mean Fisher; actual compiled smooth shape JVP at old weights and finite FP32 bank shapes. All cross terms retained; no physical PG or return-efficiency inference.
limitations: First bank is reconstructed old+stored delta; endpoint bank is independently recorded exact model_after_update.
Compiled JVP numerical certification requires the separate full captured chord audit; finite-vs-linear discrepancy mixes curvature and rounding.
Stored PPO ascent credit uses exact sign-conditioned clipped surrogate on fixed old rollout and its saved GAE; it is not physical PG.
Epoch pairings use each recorded clipped loss gradient at reconstructed preceding weights, not the old-policy score or a decomposition of finite returns.
No hypothetical optimizer updates, tangent projection of free body weights, physical-field fitting, optimizer-state reconstruction or candidate selection.

replay_validation.logits_source: Actual pinned compiled actor forward; snapshot has no independently saved latent logits; no inversion or floor-latent certification.

reconstruction.first_policy_source: Old FP32 state plus stored first retracted delta; original first endpoint was not independently saved; subtraction/addition roundoff remains.
reconstruction.endpoint_policy_source: Exact full model_after_update; actor banks use its exact recorded actor tensors.
